# Steam Vault v1.3.1

**Release date:** 2026-10-15
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning

## ✨ Highlights

Steam Vault v1.3.1 delivers an upgraded, modular **Store Notifications & Alerts Engine** across all enabled storefront platforms, introducing verified 100% free game giveaway detection, real-time store deals, and official game patch notes.

This patch resolves promotion false-positives by strictly isolating active 100% free giveaways from regular on-sale titles, organizes the notifications dashboard into a 3-tab layout (Free Games, Deals & Promotions, Patch Notes), moves Settings access to an ergonomic gear button at the bottom-left corner of the sidebar, and adds seamless Epic Online Services (EOS) overlay management.

---

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

- **Multi-Platform Free Game Promotions & Giveaways Engine (`platforms::promotions`)**:
  - Implemented modular, per-platform promotion fetchers for Epic Games (`epic.rs`), Steam (`steam.rs`), GOG (`gog.rs`), and multi-platform aggregator (`gamerpower.rs`).
  - Distinguishes active 100% free games to keep forever from upcoming giveaways with dedicated "Claim on Platform ↗" and "Preview ↗" browser actions.
  - Highlights promotion values (e.g. "Worth $19.99") and expiration dates directly on promotion cards.

- **Store Deals & Promotions Integration (`get_store_deals`)**:
  - Real-time deals engine surfacing featured Steam specials and discounts, Epic Games store sales, and GOG catalog deals.
  - Displays visual discount badges (`-75%`, `-60%`), original strikethrough pricing, and final sale prices.

- **Library Game Patch Notes Feed (`get_library_patch_notes`)**:
  - Automatically queries official update announcements and changelogs for installed library titles via Steam's News API.
  - Automatically sanitizes BBCode/HTML markup and provides direct links to full official developer announcements in the browser.

- **Unified 3-Tab Notifications Dashboard Window**:
  - The dashboard header features an interactive `🔔 Notifications` button with live alert counter pills.
  - Expands into an integrated sub-panel with dedicated tabs: **🎁 Free Games** (active & upcoming separated), **🏷️ Deals & Promotions**, and **📰 Patch Notes**.

- **Downloads & Component Status Subpage**:
  - Dedicated sub-window on the dashboard providing real-time visibility into tool downloads (e.g. Legendary CLI) and gaming overlay components.

- **Epic Online Services (EOS) Overlay Management**:
  - Integrated EOS overlay detection and one-click installation via Legendary CLI backend.

---

## ✅ Changed

- **Ergonomic Settings Navigation**: Relocated the Settings access button from the main navigation strip to a dedicated gear cog button pinned at the bottom-left corner of the sidebar, rotating smoothly on hover.
- **Platform Card Cleanliness**: Standardized the Epic Games card in Settings to match uniform launcher styling without redundant nested panels, moving custom executable paths and EOS overlay options into a clean `⚙ Legendary & EOS Settings` drawer.

---

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Free Game Promotion Filter False Positives**: Resolved an issue where paid on-sale games or upcoming titles with non-zero discounted prices leaked into active free game notifications by strictly validating `price.totalPrice.discountPrice == 0` and active 0% promotional offers.
- **Legendary Account Authentication Parser**: Fixed regex and prefix matching for active Legendary CLI sessions by properly recognizing `Epic account:` and `Account ID:` output lines.

## 🛠️ Build, Installation & Verification

Steam Vault is built with Tauri v2, Rust 1.77+, SvelteKit, and Vite.

### Local Build Commands

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/HELIX-Origin/Steam-Vault.git
cd Steam-Vault

# Install frontend dependencies
npm install

# Run automated test & verification suite
node scripts/test.mjs

# Build local production release (unsigned)
npm run tauri:build:release
```

### Verification Results

All automated verification test suites passed cleanly prior to release:
- **Rust Type-Check (`cargo check`)**: `PASS` (0 errors)
- **Rust Unit & Integration Tests (`cargo test`)**: `PASS` (43/43 tests passing)
- **Frontend Svelte Type-Check (`svelte-check`)**: `PASS` (0 errors, 0 warnings across all routes and components)
- **i18n Multi-Language Engine (`verify-i18n.mjs`)**: `PASS` (30/30 official Steam platform languages validated)
